data_fields.name: sprite_slot_limit
data_fields.donor_constant: 16382 (slot capacity rounded down to whole chunks; 16200 derived)

best_idea: Bake static tiles in fixed-size chunks, re-bake only the chunks in view whose tiles changed, and skip the whole pass when the view and team have not changed.
decision_why: Take the chunk bake, dirty-in-view re-bake and view early return for zone static geometry in Three.js; reject the zoom LOD as written because Frankendom's camera has no zoom; keep any distance-based LOD as a separate design.
acceptance: Walking through a zone with no tile change keeps frame time flat; a client test asserts that a second prepare with the same view and team bakes nothing, and that one tile change in view bakes exactly one chunk.
